ITA-1.9.4.2.2 guruḥ गुरुः
Heaviness
The quality of a substance which is responsible for nourishment.

ITA-9.2.60 guruprāvaraṇam गुरुप्रावरणम्
Sweating induced by wearing heavy clothes
A type of sudation therapy in which diaphoresis is achieved by putting on thick clothes.

ITA-1.9.4.2.1 śārīra-guṇāḥ/gurvādiguṇāḥ शारीर-गुणाः/गुर्वादिगुणाः
Physical attributes, properties or qualities
The property of a substance which is related to body tissues; it is extensively used for selecting and preparing Ayurveda medicines and applying them successfully.
